details.title: Review measuring station

confirm.title: Choose the measurements
confirm.description:
**{station}**

Pick the measurements to add as sensors. Preselected is what the station reports at the moment, but the choice is not limited to that: a pollutant the station is currently skipping can be ticked all the same and starts delivering as soon as it is back.

Every ticked measurement costs one request per update, every 30 minutes. All of this can be changed later under *Configure*.

data.advanced: Choose the other entities as well

data_description.advanced: Sub-indices, station index and coordinates. Left unticked, they are added to match the selection above.

extras.title: The other entities
extras.description: These are added on top of the measurements.

data.station_index: Station index (air quality index and level)

data_description.indexes: A sub-index needs the current value of its pollutant. That value is fetched for it even when the measurement itself is not selected.
data_description.station_index: Needs NO₂ and particulate matter. Without O₃ the milder EEA rule for traffic stations applies, and the index cannot account for ozone. The values it needs are fetched regardless of the selection above.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the data source.
error.no_stations: No measuring station found. Increase the search radius or change the search term.
error.all_configured: All matching measuring stations are already set up.
error.too_many_stations: Too many matches. Please enter a more specific search term.

abort.already_configured: This measuring station is already configured.

init.description:
**{station}**

What this station provides as entities. Unticked entities are not deleted: they stay in the registry with their history and come back unchanged when they are ticked again.

Every ticked measurement costs one request per update, every 30 minutes.

data.station_index: Station index (air quality index and level)

data_description.measurements: The full catalogue, not only what the station reports today.
data_description.station_index: Needs NO₂ and particulate matter. Without O₃ the milder EEA rule for traffic stations applies, and the index cannot account for ozone.
